newsitem.title: USA: Ametek calls meeting to approve merger.
newsitem.headline: Ametek calls meeting to approve merger.

text.p: Ametek Inc said Tuesday it set a special shareholders meeting to approve the sale of its water filtration business to Culligan Water Technologies Inc.
The company set the meeting for July 30, 1400 EDT / 1800 GMT in the Ritz Carlton hotel in Philadelphia.
Culligan said on February 5 it would buy Ametek's water filtration business for $155 milion including $25 million in assumed debt.
An Ametek spokesman said the company's shareholders will receive $130 million, or about 3.5 million of Culligan shares valued at a fixed price of $37.50 per share.
Ametek's stock traded at 24 Monday morning, up 1/2 and close to its 52-week high of 24-3/8. Culligan's shares traded at 44-1/8, down 5/8.
